reviews.quote: Jenna’s place was perfect for our family get together. All three generations and our granddog really enjoyed the stay. The house is well equipped , location is quiet and center of Kendall less than 10min walk away. Highly recommended.
Loved it. Amazing house. So big. Massive garden. Great location walk to everything nothing to complain about and the host was very helpful

Jennas place was lovely. We had a really great time there. It is set right in the centre of Kendal, just over the footbridge, but you'd never know when you're in it. It is quite, peaceful and sitting in the garden is lovely. There are quite a few stairs, which wasn't a problem for us but worth noting. The kitchen is full of utensils but if cooking bring your own oil, cling film etc. There were some herbs in the cupboard and Jennna kindly left us some milk. The house was absolutely spotless, rooms were massive and the beds and sofas were comfy. The hosts were really responsive and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay!

We had a fantastic stay here for 4 days for 3 couples and 1 child. Location was excellent for being parable to walk to walk to shops/bars/restaurants and close by for a short drive over the the lakes. Super comfortable and plenty of space.

We had a wonderful stay in Kendal. The house was beautiful, elegant, and exceeded all of our expectations. It was spotless, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a relaxing visit. Jenna was an exceptional host—friendly and incredibly accommodating. She responded promptly to all of our questions and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our stay. We couldn't have asked for a better experience and would highly recommend this property to anyone visiting the area. We would happily stay here again!
We had a lovely stay in this charming property. Excellent garden space. The cottage was spacious and comfortable.
Great experience in a lovely air bnb! Jenna was a great host, a really nice person :)

My family and I stayed here for 3 nights for a family wedding nearby. The house was absolutely perfect. It was spotlessly clean, the kitchen was really well stocked with equipment and the house was well maintained. We stayed during a summer heatwave but the tiled floors and large sash windows helped to keep us cool. The garden was very large so great for getting outside. It’s just a short stroll into Kendal and perfect for accessing the wider Lake District.
lovely grand house, big rooms and well decorated, sympathetic to the style and age of the house. comfortable living room and bedrooms. kitchen was adequate with lots of equipment.

Brilliant place to stay in Kendal. Beautiful place - lots of space and large rooms. Super clean and comfortable. Ideal setup for a mixed group. Just 5 mins walk from centre of Kendal for lovely shops and restaurants. And great proximity to Lake Windermere driving or on bus. We’ll be back next year!

We had a great stay. The house is very spacious, and for a group of us doing a running event nearby, it couldn't have fitted our needs better. Good location, super comfy beds, friendly hosts. if you have more than one car, just consider the logistics first. Best to turn cars round before others arrive. Would definitely suit families or groups of friends. Would happily return.

Just returned from a fabulous few days at Jenna’s home in Kendal. The house is gorgeous! Big spacious rooms and bedrooms. Kitchen has everything, if a little dated. There are boxes of nice kids toys, which went down very well. Games and books too. The garden was amazing for the kids. Location is great. Close to a wood so doesn’t feel as close to town as it is. Easy to walk into Kendal for shops and restaurants.

We really enjoyed our stay in Kendal. The place was easy to find and check-in was seamless thanks to Jenna’s clear instructions. It was great value for money, looked exactly like the pictures, and was within walking distance to all the local amenities in Kendal — exactly what we were looking for. We’d happily return. Thanks Jenna!

We had a great time at this big but cosy house, 8 of us had loads of space, beds were super comfy and the 😁 location was perfect, a short walk to lots of restaurants and bars, we could park the cars and not need to drive anywhere for the time we were there. We would love to go back and stay again
Fantastic house, great location, quiet street - lovely garden for the kids. Had one question about the tv and was answered on text immediately by Jenna. Great service. Would stay again.
Great property to stay in for the weekend with plenty of local conveniences and a helpful host
Great place to stay and close to everything. We enjoyed the place and would definitely recommend.

We had an absolutely amazing stay. I can't say enough good things about the house, location and Jenna as a host. Even more spacious than it seems in pictures! Homely, cosy and warm with loads of games and books 💕 as well. Really quiet as well and comfy beds. Well equipped kitchen. Jenna was so helpful and gave us early check in / late check out AND sorted us access to an extra bathroom Make sure to visit Bowness Bay Brewery at the end of the road! (swinging into the drive is a bit tight so take care with big cars)
Jenna was responsive and the property was as described, in a good location to explore Kendal and the surrounding area

We had a great time here, lots on your door step as well as easy drives to other locations. Perfect place to stay with family everything you could need. Especially if you have a young family, even had toys that my car/train obsessed little boy loved. Jenna was a greats host and really responsive. Would definitely book again.
Amazing property and was great to spend my son's first christmas! Great location for visiting family in Kendal, felt very at home would love to stay again.
Great location and great accommodation. We had a great weekend stay. Many thanks

Spacious home, perfect for families. It would have been a nice touch to have bath soap provided as mentioned in the description. Nonetheless, we really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend this place to other travelers.

Great location for town centre (10 mins walk) and walks to the castle and nice walk to Cunswick Scar. Never used the car all weekend. Spacious property and dog friendly, just be careful that the garden is not secure. Bathrooms very tastefully presented. Jenna was a great host, really good communication and flexible on check in and check out. We all had a great weekend.

We had a wonderful time at this property! Jenna is very friendly and responsive. On top of the well equipped kitchen and amenities, we were pleasantly surprised by the many boards games, books, and even children’s toys that was available at the house. There was even a baby high chair prepared for my toddler even though we didn’t ask for one. The property is in a lovely location right next to the river and the view is amazing. It’s very peaceful yet within walking distance to town! Everyone was very happy and would highly recommended this place to anyone who’s looking to explore Lake District!

We stayed for my best friends 30th and we had the best time. Location was fantastic, the house was beautiful. Everything we wanted and more! Jenna was such a kind host and was super helpful and responsive in the lead up to the visit. The house was ready for us when we got there and we wouldn’t change a thing.
Great stay. Able to walk in and out of Kendal centre, spacious house. All amenities needed present. Thanks so much, would come again
A lovely house ideally situated in Kendal. Loads of space for six of us - highly recommended.
Lovely house , clean , everything you need, walking distance into town and pubs

We really enjoyed our stay. The house is in an excellent location for exploring Kendal and surrounding areas. The host was excellent, very accommodating and flexible with the check out time that day which we really appreciated

Our multi-generational family group spent several days at Olrig Bank and had a great time. We appreciated the off-road parking for several cars and the garden for the children to play in. The property was clean and the beds comfy. The kitchen was very well equipped and made self-catering easy. As a family, we had a game of putting, walked up to the ruins of Kendal Castle and did a town trail, all without needing to get in the car. We would definitely stay here again if we were in the area.

We really enjoyed our visit to Jenna's property, the location was perfect for the town centre and had a lovely garden and off-road parking. Entering the house made quite an impression with the large Victorian tiled hallway and stairs. The decoration and feel of the house was very in keeping with the age of the property. The bathrooms were modern, new and sparkling, great showers. The kitchen was of an older style, but well equipped and a welcome pack and essentials kindly provided, so that you can have a lovely cuppa after your journey, and don't arrive to no supplies, which was very appreciated. The two main bedrooms were very generous in size and very comfortable. The twin bedroom would be better for children, but perfectly adequate. The dining and living room were a great size again, and comfortable but could maybe do with an additional sofa or extra chairs to cater for the 8 guests that the house can accommodate. All in all, we loved it and had a lovely stay and would return.

We had a wonderful stay at the property. It's a large house with plenty of space and a good garden too! The host was very responsive, kind and helpful. Fantastic spot to explore the lake district and I'd highly recommend staying here. Thanks Jenna for a wonderful stay!
Good host and location. We had a pleasant stay!

Our Airbnb stay with Jenna in Kendal, Lake District, was an absolute gem—what a great deal! Jenna proved to be the perfect host, welcoming us warmly and making sure we had everything we needed. The space itself was immaculate, with spotless bathrooms that felt fresh and well-cared for. The kitchen was a standout: fully stocked with all the utensils, appliances, and cookware you could need, making meal prep for our group of 9 a breeze. Fast, reliable Wi-Fi kept everyone connected, which was a nice bonus. Spacious enough for 8-10 people without feeling cramped, it was the ideal base for exploring the Lake District. We’d happily stay here again—highly recommend!
Great location for Kendal. Ample parking. Large property with lots of space and everything you need for a stay in the Lakes. Very clean and tidy with great showers.

My friends and I really enjoyed staying at Olrig Bank. Jenna was proactive and responsive in her communications. The house was very clean and had everything for a group of 6. Located within walking distance of Kendal town centre and some picturesque walks
lovely house . great location

Our family really enjoyed staying at the Victorian period house. The rooms were all large, great for meals and entertaining. The town center and some nice pubs were within 5 mins walk. Our host Jenna was very responsive.

Lovely, spacious house and great location. Jenna was an excellent host and very helpful. Great for the kids - our little boy loved the box of toys! Everywhere was nice and clean, very well equipped kitchen.

This lovely period property was perfect for a family get together and a great location for exploring Kendal. It was really spacious and well-equipped with a lovely garden and surrounding spaces. Jenna was the ideal host and we would definitely stay again.
Lovely place to stay for 2 nights and the host was very helpful.

Stunning house in a perfect location for visiting the Lake District. The house is very spacious, ideal for a group of 8 people. Kitchen is very well equipped with everything you need to cook for a couple of days. Bedrooms are spacious and beds really comfy. The 2 bathrooms are spotless and both equipped with a shower - great for sharing the house with a large group. Toddlers and babys friendly - there's plenty of books and toys for all age entertainment! The area is very quiet and walkable distance to the centre of town. Plenty of space to park the car on the rear of the property. Jenna has been really helpful throughout our stay. Thanks again for your hospitality!
Super friendly and responsive host! Cottage is very spacious and perfectly located within in walking distance of Kendal. Would recommend to groups of friends visiting the lakes

Beautiful period property in an ideal location to explore Kendal and the lakes. Jenna was quick to reply to any questions and incredibly helpful. We would highly recommend and will hopefully visit again soon.
Ideal accommodation for a big group trip, 20min drive from windemere and 10min walk into kendal town made it easy access for all requirements. Responsive host and overall very smooth experience!

Had a lovely stay in this very spacious beautiful house, beautiful longe and dining room with lots of games and books to use. Ideal for 8 guests and very clean and tidy. Beds and mattresses were wonderful, all had an excellent nights sleep. Large garden which we managed to sit out in the sun. Very convenient to Kendal town centre. Excellent value for money and would highly recommend.

Thank you so much for a wonderful stay! Jenna’s place is ideally located with easy walking distance to shops/cafes and off road parking for several cars. The place was beautiful, spacious and spotlessly clean. The beds were very comfortable. The place has everything you need and Jenna went to additional trouble to make our stay extra special with some finishing touches including a craft activity left for our children. Thank you so much!

Great property in walking distance to all of then pubs/restaurants in Kendal. Really good spot to use as a base when visiting Lake District. Spacious home with great communal areas and comfortable bedrooms.
Jenna was a fantastic host. Really responsive. Lovely place

I stayed for three nights for the kendal mountain film festival and it's perfectly located for the town. It's such a lovely big house to come back to loads of space and everything you need. Helpful to have off street parking and Jenna was really helpful throughout with the booking.
Clear communication, spacious clean room, beautiful period home. Thanks for a great stay!
